name: Butagumi
review: Best katsu I’ve ever had in my life, and every little side dish was so flavorful and made with so much thought!

name: Taneda
review: Best omakase I’ve ever been to. Other places have had higher highs, but there were absolutely no misses: every dish was incredible. The experience itself is great, and Chef Taneda was a pleasure to talk to.

name: Soothr
review: SUCH good khao soi; the curry was on a level I don’t think it could get to. The chicken skin was still crispy and so juicy.

name: Homer
review: Really cool flavors; I hadn’t had Middle Eastern cuisine explored this way before. I want to go back for sure!

name: Unchai
review: My favorite Thai place in Vancouver, small and family owned. Their fish curry is absolutely one of my favorites, and I always go back for it.

name: Yunomi.Cafe
review: The staff were extremely friendly and knowledgeable! The teas we tried were amazing, and they put me onto hojicha strawberry lattes.

name: Nakatanidou
review: Best mochi I’ve had in my life. Perfect texture!

name: Saint Bread
review: Great options, and I loved both their savory bakes and their pastries. It’s in such a great spot to walk around, too.

name: Hiroki
review: Best bakery in Seattle. The chai is great, and so was the matcha cake.

name: Chicha San Chen
review: I LOVE their teas: amazing flavors, and worth paying a premium over the other chains.
